docs.text: Install the Catalogue Generator ¶ Install the package with pip: pip install nomad-plugins For local development, install the project from the repository and run commands through the configured development environment.
docs.title: Install the catalogue generator

docs.text: Install the package with pip: pip install nomad-plugins For local development, install the project from the repository and run commands through the configured development environment.
docs.title: Install the Catalogue Generator

docs.text: Use the Catalogue Generator ¶ The catalogue generator crawls public GitHub repositories for Python packages that expose NOMAD plugin entry points and writes the discovered metadata as JSON. Export crawler results ¶ Run the crawler with a GitHub token and an output path: plugin-catalogue crawl --github-token <token> --output plugins.json
